answer: My check is a room acoustic fingerprint. Each room answers a chirp differently, and its echo is a signature no two rooms share. First the agent plays a two second chirp and records the echo as a hash. Second, a chirp from a new angle must match. Third, the network sends a fresh pattern at random, and the agent has ten minutes. A miss burns a 250 POA bond and freezes the identity 30 days. One fake needs one real room, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 dollars a month, an atlas of leases to wander between. A thousand fakes is like a thousand boats at one jetty: no room, and everyone sees it.
